maddeler.e:
نستمسك (form X)
# نَسْتَمْسِكُ (nastamsiku) /nas.tam.si.ku/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَمْسَكَ (istamsaka)
# نَسْتَمْسِكَ (nastamsika) /nas.tam.si.ka/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَمْسَكَ (istamsaka)
# نَسْتَمْسِكْ (nastamsik) /nas.tam.sik/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَمْسَكَ (istamsaka)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
